subject: reasoning
question: Pramod starts from point A and drives 43 km north. He then turns left, drives 45 km, turns left again and drives 56 km. He then turns left again and drives 64 km. He finally turns left, drives 13 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction must he drive to reach point A again? (Unless specified, all turns are 90-degree turns only.)
solution:
**Given:**

Pramod starts from point A and drives 43 km north.

Then he turns left and drives 45 km.

Again he turns left and drives 56 km.

Then he turns left again and drives 64 km.

Finally, he turns left and drives 13 km to reach point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98723c8d775334972ef096e8f8e05aa937d2a2096e563ddc2245caafb4f43489.png] 

 

To reach point A again, he must travel **19 km towards the West**.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".**
